gloss: faculty of pharmacy; school of pharmacy

definitions.gloss: faculty of pharmacy; school of pharmacy
definitions.explanation: The division of a university that teaches pharmaceutical science and trains pharmacists.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薬学部|やくがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My daughter attends the faculty of pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {薬学部|やくがくぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六年制|ろくねんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many faculties of pharmacy have a six-year program.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬剤師|やくざいし}→薬剤師：07030_yakuzaishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薬学部|やくがくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
Compound of ⟦{薬学|やくがく}→薬学：19156_yakugaku⟧ (pharmaceutical science) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (faculty). The six-year program qualifies graduates to sit the national pharmacist exam.
